ancient.0.author: Polybe
ancient.0.title: Imezruyen
ancient.0.desc: Tiɣbula tameqqrant ɣef sin imenɣan ipunikiyen imezwura akked umennuɣ n Yimirsinariyen, s wawal n yimtawiyen gar Ṛuma d Qarṭaǧ ; Polybe yella-d deg uɣelluy n 146. Iteddu s tarrayt, maca iqerrib ɣer wat Scipion akked tmuɣli taṛumit.
ancient.1.author: Tite-Live
ancient.1.title: Amezruy n Ṛuma (idlisen XXI–XXX)
ancient.1.date: Taggara n lqern wis 1 uq.Ɛ., talatinit
ancient.1.desc: Tiqsiṭ s telqayt tugar tiyaḍ, ɣef umennuɣ apunik wis sin, seg Sagonte ar Zama. Tura-t deg lweqt n Auguste iwakken a d-isali Ṛuma : aṭas n ddrama, awalen i d-yettwabnan, udem n Hannibal yettwabeggen-d d acengu (« lexdeɛ apunik »).
ancient.2.author: Appien d'Alexandrie
ancient.2.title: Libyca (Adlis n Tefriqt)
ancient.2.desc: Yiwen n usebter kan i d-ihedren ɣef umennuɣ apunik wis tlata akked uɣelluy n Qarṭaǧ. Yezmer ad yesseqdec idlisen n Polybe i yeruḥen. Tura-t ɣer deffir, s wawal n wiyaḍ. Ixsayen d wayen i d-yettwabeggnen ilaq ad ttwaxedmen s lefhama.
ancient.3.author: Diodore de Sicile
ancient.3.title: Lmaktaba n Umezruy
ancient.3.desc: Ulac win ara t-yerren deg wayen yeɛnan imenɣan n Qarṭaǧ di Sicile (Himère, Denys n Syracuse, Agathocle di Tefriqt). D ajmuɛ n tektabin n yimezruyen igrikiyen n Sicile am Timée, i yellan aṭas n tikwal d iɛdawen n yiqarṭaǧiyen.
ancient.4.author: Plutarque
ancient.4.title: Tudarin Imqabalen (Timoléon, Fabius Maximus, Marcellus, Caton Aqbur)
ancient.4.date: Lqern wis 1 ar wis 2 dffr Ɛ., tagrikt
ancient.4.desc: Isban-d Qarṭaǧ s wallen n yiɛdawen-is: amennuɣ n Timoléon di Sicile, tarrayt n Fabius zdat Hannibal, Caton akked tazart n Qarṭaǧ. D ameskar n tudert i yeḥwajen aktar lxelq wala tagnit n wussan.
ancient.5.author: Justin
ancient.5.title: Agzum n Imezruyen Ifilipiyen n Trogue Pompée (idlisen XVIII–XIX)
ancient.5.date: Azmez amgarad (lqern wis 2 ar wis 4 dffr Ɛ.), talatinit
ancient.5.desc: Tiqsiṭ tameqqrant ɣef tasnulfa n Qarṭaǧ sɣur Élissa akked wussan-is imezwura (Malchus, At Magon). D agzum yuran ɣer deffir n wedlis yeruḥen seg zzman n Auguste : lexyal d umezruy mxalafen deg-s.
ancient.6.author: Cornelius Nepos
ancient.6.title: Tudarin n Hamilcar d Hannibal
ancient.6.desc: D tudarin-nni n zik i d-yegran kan ɣef iqayden n Qarṭaǧ, i yesɛan asaḥ ɣer Hannibal. Wezznin aṭas, zgan ɛeggun deg telqayt, yerna kra tikwal d tuccḍiwin.
ancient.7.author: Aristote
ancient.7.title: Tasertit (adlis wis 2)
ancient.7.desc: D yiwen ara yesleḍen anagraw n Qarṭaǧ di zzman-is (isufiten, Asqamu, Imeqqranen n 104, tajmaɛt n ugdud), yettwaɛuzzen am lqanun yemxalafen yerna iqam. Tamuɣli n umusnaw agrigi, i yettqeysen Qarṭaǧ s lmizan n Sparte d Crète.
ancient.8.author: Pline l'Ancien
ancient.8.title: Amezruy n Tgama
ancient.8.desc: Yeḥrez-d kra n tɣawsiwin igerrzen : adlis n tfellaḥt n Magon yettwasuqel ɣer talatinit s lameṛ n Usqamu, iberdan n Hannon d Himilcon, tazart n Caton. D adlis ameqqran i yesdukklen aṭas n telqayat war asleḍ.
ancient.9.author: Strabon
ancient.9.title: Tussna n Tmurt (adlis wis 17)
ancient.9.date: Lqern wis 1 uq.Ɛ. ar wis 1 dffr Ɛ., tagrikt
ancient.9.desc: Yebder-d amḍiq n Qarṭaǧ, Byrsa akked yibeḥriyen-is, yerna yewwi-d imḍanen (700 000 n yimezdaɣ, 300 n temdinin di Libya) ahat ɛerqen. D amassan n tmurt i yxedmen s wawal n wiyaḍ, seg wacḥal aya i tettwahud Qarṭaǧ.
ancient.10.author: Silius Italicus
ancient.10.title: Punica (asefru ameqqran)
ancient.10.desc: Asefru ameqqran deg sbeɛtaɛac n yiḥerfan ɣef umennuɣ apunik wis sin, asefru talatinit ɛemmer aktar n wiyaḍ yettwaḥerzen. D taẓuri n tira, mačči d taɣbalut n umezruy : iṛebbiten, targit akked yimenɣan n yiɛdawen am akken yura Virgile.
ancient.11.author: Anonyme
ancient.11.title: Abrid n Hannon
ancient.11.desc: Ibeggen-d iman-is d asuqel n tira yettwaskanen sɣur Hannon deg uxxam n ssjada n Qarṭaǧ, yemmeslay-d ɣef ubrid rrif n trawin n Tefriqt n Lɣarb. D yiwet n tira kan n uɣbalu aqarṭaǧi seg wagi ; azemz-is, abrid-is d tseḥqiqt n usuqel mazal-iten d imgaraden.
